items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's a guy called Snooks Eaglin. We'll play you a little record by here in a minute.

ctx.x: That's a guy called Snooks Eaglin. We'll play you a little record by here in a minute. What time you gotta leave, Danny? We'll leave about a quarter after nine. It's about that time now.
After nine, yeah? I gotta start splitting down it.
